svg.text: Upload flow: direct-to-S3 uploads with a pre-signed URL
• Files go straight to S3, not through the API.
• The signed URL expires after 5 minutes.
• SQS absorbs bursts; the DLQ keeps bad messages.
1 request URL 2 invoke Lambda 3 signed URL returned 4 PUT upload 5 S3 event 6 poll queue 7 start workflow 8 failures to DLQ
